name: academic-writing-suite
description: Academic research workflow orchestrator: direction intake, deep-research capability probe (hard stop when absent), gated experiment design, anti-defensive outline, journal confirmation, citation audit, bidirectional claim calibration, and subagent-based blinded peer review with P0-P3 blockers. Acts as research advisor — never ghostwrites, never predicts acceptance odds.
descriptionZh: 学术研究全流程编排：启动问询定写作方向→深度研究能力探针（无工具即硬中断并给出交接 prompt）→门禁后实验设计→反防御骨架→目标期刊确认→引用审查→双向声明校准润色→子代理脱盲审稿（只给 P0-P3 阻塞点，不给录用概率/档位）。定位为研究导师而非代笔人——只给规划、建议和修改点，绝不产出论文正文。
